court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Mrs. Upkar Kaur Hardeepsingh Popali vs Mr. Hardeepsingh Jasvanstsingh Popali
facts_of_case: The applicant/wife seeks transfer of Marriage Petition no.1974/2017, filed by the respondent/husband, pending before the learned Civil Judge, Senior Division, Khamgaon.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to show that the transfer of proceedings is necessary.
legal_principles.held: By this application u/s 24 of CPC, the applicant/wife is seeking transfer of Marriage Petition no.1974/2017, filed by respondent/husband pending before learned Civil Judge, Senior Division, Khamgaon, u/s 13(1)(ia) and (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act,1955, and other matter to Civil Judge, Senior Division, Pune and/or Family Court at Pune.

legal_principles.principle: The applicant must undertake to serve the respondent by hand delivery along with the entire proceeding and file an affidavit of service to that effect.
legal_principles.held: Learned advocate for applicant submits that applicant undertakes to serve the respondent by hand delivery alongwith entire proceeding and file affidavit of service to that effect.

outcome.final_order: The applicant is directed to serve the respondent by private notice alongwith entire proceeding, either by RPAD and/or hand delivery, stating that, the matter will be decided finally at the stage of admission itself.

use_for_drafting: seeking urgent orders in family court
